cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -H "$H" $B/organizations/org_fixture/spend-budget; echo; curl -s -H "$H" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture"}' -i $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs | tee run1.txt | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -H "$H" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture"}' -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs | tee run2.txt

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; curl -s -H "$H" -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"suiteId":"suite_fixture"}' -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' $B/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs | tee run3.txt

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1 > status.json; grep -qE '"status": "(completed|failed|cancelled|timed_out)"' status.json && break; sleep 5; done; cat status.json | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s -H "$H" $B/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations | head -c 1200

cd /workspace; H="Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY"; B=$MCPJAM_API_URL; for p in projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/run_fixture_1 projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/run_fixture_1/iterations; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -H "$H" $B/$p | head -c 1200; echo; done | tee result.txt
